text: Completed bounded Boost feasibility probe in well under four hours. BH1.90.0.1/BSL1.0 and CGAL GPLv3 preflight recorded. Fixed12cases: analytic20px finite axes retained under shifts, 0.4px gap preserved where raster masks coincide, independent distance/ownership checks pass; overlap, overflow and topology-changing quantization rejected. Compile1.5-1.8s, sampled180-188MiB. Curved and unbounded edges explicitly unsupported; go for separately scoped backend study, no production/default/dependency change. Full code, initial/final evidence, inspected figure, timebox and report at tools/voronoi and docs/VORONOI_SPIKE.md.
